notes.title: Welcome, new Spartans!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to see so many of you take advantage of playing Metro 2033 Redux in our 15th Anniversary giveaway! We sincerely hope you enjoy navigating the beginning of Artyom's journey - we cannot wait to hear what you think! 

We would like to take this opportunity to welcome you to the Metro community, and give you a quick tour of the tunnels. 

There are 4 games in the Metro story so far (in order of release)... 

[b]Metro 2033 (you are here) [/b]

[b]Metro: Last Light [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/287390/Metro_Last_Light_Redux/

[b]Metro Exodus[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/412020/Metro_Exodus/

[b]Metro Awakening (VR only) [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2669410/Metro_Awakening/

[b]Our top tips for survival: [/b]
[list]
[*] Be vigilant, listen to the sounds of your environment, you never know where the next threat is coming from.
[*] Manage your filters and Bullets - these are scarce resources, don't spend them too quickly, make decisions with your survival in mind.
[*] MGR is ammunition as well as currency, spend it wisely.
[*] There are 2 endings to Metro games, your choices matter. 
[*] There is no shame in running if you need to. 
[*] Pick your weapon loadout based on Ammo, we wouldn't recommend having 2 weapons that use the same ammo type, unless you have a death wish. 
[*] You do not have to kill everyone... something to think about. 
[*] Explore and scavenge. Sometimes the most surprising things can be found this way. 
[*] Immerse yourself in the story and let it take you on a journey, you will not regret it. 
[/list]

Feel free to ask the community and us any questions you may have, we are always happy to welcome new survivors to the tunnels, and other Spartans are on hand to lend a hand!

A taster of what you can expect: 
[previewyoutube=RbADeT1-HLw;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]PLUS,[/b] if you are already yearning for more, a new mainline game is in development now at 4A Games - [url=https://www.4a-games.com.mt/4a-dna/2025/3/16/metro-15th-anniversary-update]check out the latest news on this here. [/url]

If not us, then who? 

- Team Metro

notes.title: Introducing: Metro Awakening – A new VR Metro game by Vertigo Games
notes.notes:
Deep Silver and Vertigo Games are pleased to announce a new addition to the Metro franchise. Metro Awakening is a story-driven first-person adventure built exclusively for VR and will be coming to Steam VR, PS VR2 and Meta Quest 2+3 later this year. 

Developed by Vertigo Games in collaboration with Deep Silver, and written by Metro creator Dmitry Glukhovsky, Metro Awakening allows you to immerse yourself in the heart-pounding, chilling and tense world of Metro in an entirely new dimension. 

Set in 2028, you are Serdar, a doctor who has to brave the mind-bending tunnels of Metro to search for his missing wife. This journey will push his mind to the limit – walking a line between life and death, rationality and spirituality, reality and belief. Serdar will experience what he once thought was impossible, awakening the force he is to become.  

Lose yourself in an authentic Metro experience as you reload weapons, change your filters, charge your torch, and more, in a tactile experience that VR and Metro fans will love and put yourself into nuclear Armageddon.

There will be more news coming later this year – tune your radios and join the Metro community for all the latest Metro news 

Wishlist now: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2669410/Metro_Awakening/

notes.title: The 10 Best Games Based On Books
notes.notes:
Books! They’re like films without pictures, or games that are all cutscene. Old people and hipsters really like them, teenagers think they’re like totally lame, and quite frankly we should all read more of them. There are countless games inspired by books – most especially Tolkien, Lovecraft and early Dungeons & Dragon fiction – but surprisingly few games based directly on books. Even fewer good ones.

Perhaps one of the reasons for that is that a game can, in theory, cleave closer to what a book does than a film can – with their length and their word counts, their dozens of characters and in some cases even their own in-game books, they can to some degree do the job of a novel. They don’t need to be based on books – and often they can do so much more, thanks to the great promise of non-linearity. Of course, the real reason for the dearth is that novels are so rarely the massive business a movie is these days. You might get a forlorn Hunger Games tie-in here and there, but suited people in gleaming office blocks just aren’t going to commission an adaptation of the latest Magnus Mills tale, more’s the pity.

I suspect that, over time, we’ll see the non-corporate side of games development increasingly homage the written word, but for now, these ten games (and seven honourable mentions) are, as far as I’m concerned, the best, and most landmark, results of page-to-pixel adaptation to date.

notes.title: Return to the Metro with METRO REDUX!
notes.notes:
This Summer, [b]Metro Redux[/b] collects two re-mastered and improved versions of the classic Metro games -- [b]Metro 2033 Redux[/b] and [b]Metro: Last Light Redux[/b].

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_AhRNaRr3PQ

For [b]Metro 2033 Redux[/b], Metro 2033 has been rebuilt using the newest version of the powerful 4A Engine, last seen in action in Metro: Last Light. That means advanced lighting, dynamic weather, higher detail for characters with improved animation, more dynamic destruction, and improved smoke, fire, and particle effect.

[b]Metro: Last Light Redux[/b] has also received a upgrade, including new melee animations and the fan-requested ‘Check Watch’ and ‘Check Inventory’ features. All previously released Metro: Last Light DLC will be included in this Redux version.

[h1]New ways to play[/h1]
Both Redux versions will now feature two modes of play: [b]‘Survival’[/b] and [b]‘Spartan’[/b]. [b]Survival[/b] lets you play either game in Metro 2033's more survival-horror oriented style, with deadlier enemies, slower reloading, and more limited resources. [b]Spartan[/b] lets you play either game in the Last Light style, with more polished combat and more plentiful resources.

Ranger Mode is included for free in both Redux versions, and can be combined with Survival or Spartan modes, leading to a total of four modes of play for each game.

Read the full announcement with all details on the official website: http://enterthemetro.com/uk/news/game_information_uk/return_to_post_apocalyptic_moscow/
